reason: Radix Menubar numbers ids with useId; the port generates them on the server and lets the caller name them (item #14 of the standalone epic).
api: Menubar id: keeps React's meaning (the id of the element) and also seeds the generated ids (app-menubar-menu-1); Radix numbers ids with React's useId (unique per tree, no caller control); the port numbers them per request with the Rails engine and per render otherwise (Chadcn::Sequence), and the root takes an explicit base; a Menu without value: gets <id>-menu-N, which is also its content id
